name: Four Seasons Hotel Dalian
positioning: Four Seasons hotel in the central business district of Dalian, with restaurants and bars on the topmost floors and a 38th-floor infinity pool
best_for: Travelers who want a central Dalian base with harbour and city views
Guests who like dining and drinks in one tower

facts.text: The hotel has 204 guest rooms and 50 suites.
The hotel is at 45 Zhuyu Street, Zhongshan District, Dalian.
The hotel is located at the heart of the Donggang CBD.
The hotel is a 30-minute drive from Dalian Zhoushuizi International Airport.
The hotel is steps from Gangwan Square station on Line 2 of the Dalian Metro.
The Sky Lobby is on the 41st floor.
Saai Yue Heen, the signature Chinese restaurant, is on the 39th floor.
Bath amenities are from the fragrance brand Frédéric Malle.
The hotel has a 24-hour Fitness Centre.
The interior design draws inspiration from a luxurious European retro train.

highlights.text: The hotel has an infinity swimming pool on the 38th floor.
Saai Yue Heen has an open kitchen and a two-tier seafood tank.
Yotsuba is an authentic Japanese restaurant with sushi and sashimi.
Hui Hai is an all-day restaurant with live cooking stations.
Harbour Bar is a bar on the 41st floor.

considerations.text: The Spa is open daily from 10:00 am to 11:00 pm.
WhataHotel notes that premium luxury pricing reflects the hotel's high-end positioning.
WhataHotel notes that some local staff members speak limited English.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
